data.gender_notes: Murabba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Murabba is an Arabic name that refers to a geometric shape, symbolizing balance and harmony. It is also associated with the concept of unity and wholeness. The name Murabba carries the meaning “Square or Cube” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murabba usually hope their child will grow to embody square or cube and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the cube represents the Kaaba, the sacred house of Allah in Mecca.
